note: No evaluator-authored executable hidden tests are frozen in this revision. The frozen Design Map deliberately leaves route names, JSON field spellings, UUID format, internal registry/backend classes, log storage representation, and the duplicate-allocation 200-vs-conflict choice as implementation freedom, so an evaluator-authored hidden test would have to invent that surface. spike.md AC20 mandates visible in-repository regression coverage for the host-owned-run behaviours, so executable evidence is the implementation's own visible regression suite (brief scope 1-11; AC01-AC09, AC11-AC20), run through `npm test`. Static and provenance cases use the modes and evidence plans frozen in eval-spec.md and case-manifest.json.
